about: Characters that could carry text the person cannot see in a message they approve on a Send card.
One rule, implemented twice without shared code: the host's send check and its AI chat card markers
(ShenzhenPDF's adapter under portable/mac) and the Friends views' literal text
rule: refused_before_card: friends_send_message refuses the text before any card shows it.
marked: what a card shows as a code point marker, in order, one entry per occurrence.
U+FE0E, U+FE0F: seen only after a base in Unicode's emoji-variation-sequences.txt;
after a keycap base (# * 0-9) only when U+20E3 follows.
U+200D: seen only between Extended_Pictographic code points; the first one's own U+FE0F
(only one seen itself), or a skin tone (U+1F3FB-1F3FF), may sit between it and the joiner;
and in an Indic conjunct: right after a Virama before a Consonant of the virama's block, or right
after such a Consonant before the virama when another such Consonant follows the virama.
U+200C: seen only where it changes a shape: between a Joining_Type D letter and a D or R letter,
or right after an Indic_Syllabic_Category Virama before a Consonant of the virama's block
(DerivedJoiningType.txt, IndicSyllabicCategory.txt and Blocks.txt, one Unicode version).
Tag characters U+E0000-E007F: refused outright, subdivision flags included; marked on a card.
Private-use characters, the braille blank U+2800, and every other zero-width, format, direction
or default-ignorable character: refused and marked.
Combining marks (Mn, Mc, Me): a mark its letter already carries, or a fifth on one letter, is refused
and marked, and so is a mark of another script: a mark fits its letter only when its Script_Extensions
(else its Script; Scripts.txt, ScriptExtensions.txt) share a script with the letter's, or it is
Inherited with no extensions (U+0338, U+20D2, U+20E3); U+0301 lists Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and others.
Quranic pause and annotation marks (U+06D6-06DC, U+06DF-06E4, U+06E7-06E8, U+06EA-06ED) also fit a
space: U+0020, or one the send check writes as U+0020 (U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-200A, U+202F, U+205F).
The letter is the last code point kept that is neither a mark nor U+200D (U+0000 before the first), so a
marked character, or a conjunct's joiner, between a letter and its marks leaves them counting on that
letter. The text is composed (NFC) first, and a letter starts out carrying the marks of its own canonical
decomposition (NFD of that one code point): U+1EC7 carries U+0323 and U+0302, U+2260 carries U+0338.
A mark is counted as NFC writes it, even one that decomposes into two (U+09CB).
